what: A color panel is layered over the section, and as you scroll it either rises from below to cover the section (cover — until the section’s bottom edge reaches the top of the screen) or lifts away upward to reveal it (reveal — until the section’s top reaches the top of the screen). The panel’s edge bows like an arc in the middle, with the bow largest at the midpoint of progress (sin) and straight at the start and end — the bow = 12 × section aspect ratio. Follows the scroll with a .3s lag

options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default cover: bottom bottom · reveal: top bottom
options.end: ScrollTrigger end, default cover: bottom top · reveal: top top

use:
…
(Panel color is --fx-arc, default --kf-bg — usually the next section’s background color)

from.where: about.html section boundary [data-fx=arc-edge-scroll] — original initArcScrollTransition: viewBox 100, curve 12 × aspect ratio, sin, scrub .3, cover bottom bottom→bottom top · reveal top bottom→top top (Brand Arc Scroll Transition)
